notes.title: Another Bugfix-Wave
notes.content:
Drinking from the sink now instantly restores thirst to max.
Fixed seams of the University-building and added a door of the Uni-Main building
Fixed an issue that caused the character to earn more than 100 exp and get stuck.
Fixed the Kitsunes shrinking-scene animations
Fixed an issue that caused the player to softlock after losing against Ray in a battle.

Fixed all reported typos and wrong pronouns

notes.title: More fixes: Cam settings, Taent-screen, minor bugs.
notes.content:
The new Camera settings are now available outside the players room too.

Fixed a bug that made available talent invisible.
Fixed some minor bug with the skullgirl ambush in town.
Fixed some visual bug that painted the hospital door black.

notes.title: New cam, some balance, some fixes
notes.content:
New feature:
Added a new camera mode in the options:
-Camera always rotates with mouse.

Balancing:
1 (heal+shield) now costs 25 willpower.

Bugfixes:
Fixed a bug that prevented getting dressing up from wardrobe.
Teeny now really sells eggs.
Couple of other minor visual bugs, typos, pronoun-fixes etc.

notes.title: fixed minor gui bug on title
notes.content: fixed minor gui bug on title

notes.title: All reported bugs fixed, some minor balancing, attack+defend bindable
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused the cursor to vanish.
Fixed the inventory-bug that caused players to accidently use items they hovered before closing the menu.
Fixed a bug that caused exp-loss after losing against cherry during the karate event
Added a toggle for fullscreen. (you can also use this to resize your GUI)
Fixed a bug that allowed players to use the toilet multiple times.
Fixed the Title screen GUI

New:
"Attack" and "Defend" in battle can now also be executed with 
Interact[E](attack) and EndureArsousal[3](defend) - (which means now you can re-bind these actions to your controller if you want)

Balancing:
Focus Life[1] (battle-ability) costs now 15 Willpower (up from 10)
Second Wind[2] (battle-ability) costs now 8 Willpower (up from 5)
Endure[3] costs now 8 Willpower (down from 10)

//Player was WAY too OP in battle

notes.title: Bowsette update, Skullgirls enslavement rework, hours of scenes and gameplay!
notes.content:
Version 2.3:

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/856639728320643082/872606542787129385/unknown.png


New:

-Bowsette Enslavement:
-> You can now talk to Papi and start serving Queen Bowsette.

-Skullgirls Enslavement 2.0:
-> Total rework of the Skullgirls Enslavement. Knock on their door or talk to Genia to start serving the Skullgirls.

-> More Lore!
-> More permanent consequences added.

Visual improvements:  Skullgirls hideout and Bowsette Castle.
Audio improvements:  Some sound effects now have adjusted audio volume.

Lots of minor Bugfixes (thx @ Discord Community)

---

2.31a Fixes:

Fixed a bug that prevented Enslavement to progress after Papis scene
Fixed wrong starting scene on Story (it should only appear on reset progress...)
The 0-button fixed.
Wrong collider inside Castle fixed.
Fixed a bug that caused to game to softlock during a koopette-surgery


2.33a fixes:
Fixed a nasty save-file issue (now everything should work properly with loading and saving...)

Skullgirls Enslavement:

The 3 Skullgirls barefeet-scene expanded (thx @ positivecarrotman)

Dumpster:

Fixed and issue that caused the old wake-up scenes to start.while sleeping near dumpster. (because they are moved into skullgirls-enslavement and bowsette-enslavement)

Bowsette Enslavement:

Scene 3 won't get stuck anymore after breakfast! You should now be able to play the other scenes.

Servant tasks:

-Resets back to 0 daily.
-You can regain Energy while working now, even under 30 Energy.
-Main hall can be cleaned after breakfast now.
-NPC's with wrong dialogues removed


2.34a fixes:

Bowsette Enslavement:

Bowsette Room is now unlocked after breakfast. (which contains the fourth broom-closet you need)
The scene will advance after foot-massage and papi-fly scene (finally)
Mimic-scene won't softlock anymore. (second time)
Mimic-scene can be repeated now daily.

Skullgirls Enslavement:
After Isabella allowing you to save your game, the game will now save.

More:
Fixed the "empty-world-bug"

2.35a fixes:

-Fixed an issue that causes the game to freeze when starting the another scene with Bowsette
-Fixed an issue which causes the 3 skull girls for the foot scene during the enslavement never to disappear and fixed their dialogues.
-The save counter from isabella is now working correctly.
-Several other minor fixes


2.36a changes:

new:
-It's possible now to dress and undress the Koopette-Servant-Uniform when entering and exiting the Enslavement-Area.


Fixes:


- Fixed a bug that prevented the campfire-skullgirls to appear when winning the fight.
- Fixed a bug that prevented interactions with Koopettes
- Fixed a bug that prevented Vanillas Enslavement.
- Fixed a weird dildo-glitch in Ponyride-Scene when playing as a female character

-Double-sharylin bug fixed (if you still see double-sharylin you must win that one fight with the standing one)
-Tried to improve performance in the Genias-Ponyride scene (should be less laggy if you have High Graphics turned off)
-Minor fixes like typos 

Balancing:

-Cherry "Shelves Minigame": Breath does not restore over time anymore.
-Using your [Shield-Restore-Ability] (1) during combat now costs 10 Willpower.
-Using your [Breath-Restore-Ability] (2) during combat now costs 5 Willpower.

2.37a changes:

Balancing:
-Clothing will now increase to 11 after battle (down from 70).
-Footcuffs, Handcuffs and Gags are not removed anymore after battle.
-Patricia (girl in dorm) can now remove Chastity for 10 Coins.

Fixes:
-Fixed an issue that caused the Permanent Koopette Shell to blink.
-Lots of typos fixed.

2.38a changes:

Fixes:

-Fixed a rare issue that caused the player to get frozen when fighting against Goblins
-Patricia now really removes chastity
-Fixed some more typos

2.39a changes:

-Multi-Mistress enslavement should be possible now.  
Balancing:
-Bowsette Enslavement is now a bit easier (cleaning costs less energy)
-Letting yourself getting used by the mimic now restores your hygiene.   

New npcs:
-Added a nurse in front of the hospital who can remove shell, tail and restore body size
-Bowsette (at the morning) will reward players with high dominance with a chiliburger
-Ophelia offers you to free you from Isabellas problem.    

Fixing performance issues / lags:
-Improved performance in the ponyride-scene
-Improved performance in the dumpster-scene

2.392a changes:

-Koopettes will now re-do their surgery if you restore your body in the hospital, before level-draining you.
-Papis minigame is now a bit easier. (player can get sucked in 2 more times before the minigame is lost, and Papi notices you earlier)

fixed some minor bugs, minor visual bugs and typos.

Enjoy! And if you like consider supporting me at:

https://www.patreon.com/SaliaCoel

notes.title: Changelog 2.2
notes.content:
Buttons revamp:
Pressing 1 to restore HP-> Removed.
The 1 button now gives you a lot of healing+shielding with a 1-minute cooldown.

Pressing 2 to restore Breath -> Removed.
The 2 button now gives you infinite breath for a short duration, then gets a 1-minute cooldown.

Pressing 3 to reduce Arousal -> Removed.
The 3 button now sets your arousal to 0 and reduces your willpower by 10.
Disabled with 0 willpower and disabled while climaxing.

Button 4 and 5 unchanged.

Changed Ireris' Blessing
Enduring Arousal ([3]) is now consuming half the willpower but now is dehydrating you. Cannot be used while thirsty.

New Enemy:

Karate Girl
A melee fighter with a counter-stance. Find her item in front of the windows of her Dojo.

Story:

Expanded Cherrys questline. You need to have solved her Quest where she wants you to hold racks).
After  you have done that go to the gym to continue.

Cherry Enslavement:
Finish her story to unlock the enslavement.
(Walkthrough: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MPRwuCR6qdI)  thx @ Zeck311

Police station:
You can now help working at the police station for some extra coins.

Skullgirls Enslavement:
If your "Skullgirls Respect"-Bar gets too low it might result in a softlock game-over.
Just knock on their door to start this. (for now,...)

Sharylin and Cristy now offer you a little job too.
And Mila is back!
